svg.text: Wires of the same colour/label connect. Every ⏚ is the same common ground. Pins are named, not drawn in board order.
Pull tach up to 3.3 V only, never 5 or 12 V.
waterproof, taped in the JBOD exhaust
Fan header, looking at the pins: 1 GND (black) · 2 +12 V (yellow/red) · 3 tach (green) · 4 PWM (blue); pin 1 is at the end next to the key.
PWM straight from the GPIO suits most fans. If a fan ignores it, drive PWM through a 2N7000 (open drain) and set PWM_INVERTED 1.
Set the buck to 5.0 V with a multimeter BEFORE connecting the ESP32.
